newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Friday 105,000 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Friday 105,000 - USDA.

text.p: Friday's estimate of interior Iowa/southern Minnesota hog marketings was 105,000 head, compared with 104,000 a week ago and 111,000 a year ago. Saturday's estimate was 15,000 head, compared with 13,000 a week ago and 42,000 a year ago.
Estimates include generally about 60 percent Carcass Base Hogs. Barrows and gilts sold $0.50 higher than midsession Thursday. Trade slow to moderate for good demand and light to moderate offerings.

Compared to last week: Barrows and Gilts steady. Sows $1.00-$3.00 higher. Receipts this week 566,000 last week 553,000, last year 586,000. Barrows and Gilts average weight for week ending Nov. 02, 1996 was 253.7 lbs compared to 252.9 lbs previous week and 252.4 lbs last year.
